login.intro: Sign in with your @icharge.com.ph work email. We send a 6-digit code to that inbox. No passwords to remember.
login.rule2: The code works once and expires in 10 minutes
login.rule3: Then sign in with your fingerprint or a 6-digit PIN
login.rule4: New staff: HR proposes, the Leader approves

login.codeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
login.privacy: By signing in you agree to the Office Hub privacy notice (Data Privacy Act, RA 10173). Trouble signing in? Ask HR.
